claims.text: Email to Peter Thiel, 28 Feb 2016: 'As you may know, I represent the Rothschilds.' (as quoted)

CBS: ~6M pages collected, ~3M released; nearly all emails from jeevacation (c. 2008); ~20,000 jeeproject messages archived by DDoSecrets missing; few littlestjeff emails; no Signal; gun inventory attachment; >70% of ~5,000 Maxwell index documents not found; Towers DOJ records not released; little massage scheduling after 2009; 23 Jul 2019 video missing; Act covers DOJ only (ICE, State, Treasury, CIA, NSA outside it); GAO investigating redactions.

CBS: DEA case opened 17 Dec 2010; 69-page 2015 memo; Epstein and 14 others; ~$50M suspicious wires 2010-15; 'judicial pending' 2015; ICE West Palm Beach 2006-08, Las Vegas 2009-10, Paris 'Operation Angel Watch' 2013; FBI 2006 case active in 2015; SDNY prosecutors in 2018 reportedly unaware of the DEA case; Indyke formed Hyperion Air and SLK Designs; his attorney denies he facilitated abuse.

ABC: Lavery removed 100+ items incl. 3 computers <2 weeks before the Oct 2005 raid at Roy Black's direction (Riley memo); given to Riley; subpoena resisted; storage paid to at least 2010; originals never found; OPR 2020: 'potentially critical'.
Julie K. Brown: removal about 12 days before 20 Oct 2005 search; Villafaña said supervisors prevented her obtaining the evidence; computers still missing.
Jmail launched Nov 2025 by Riley Walz and Luke Igel; 18.4M+ users; search counters DOJ 'technical limitations' claim.

The Logic: ~$500k in Blockstream's 2014 seed via Kyara Investments III (50/50 Epstein and Ito); stake sold months later per Adam Back; Epstein gifts of $525k to the Media Lab helped the Digital Currency Initiative hire three Bitcoin developers in 2015 (New Yorker).
